After wheat harvest, I will quickly prepare the land with rotary tillage and plant summer maize, using improved seed and a moderate fertilizer rate so I can control cost and still get dependable production. I will not spread myself across too many crops, because I would rather do two familiar crops properly than plant several crops and manage them poorly.
